2 هوّش : see 1, first sentence: ―
-b2- and see 5. ＝
-A2- Also, هَوَّشْتُهُمْ I occasioned variance between them, or among them. (Msb.) And هوّش بَيْنَهُمْ He created, or excited, disorder, disturbance, discord, or dissension, between them, or among them. (TA.) ―
-b2- And hence, (Msb,) هوّش, (S, Msb, K,) inf. n. تَهْوِيشٌ, (K,) He mixed, confused, or confounded, (S, Msb, K, TA,) a company of men, (S, TA,) one with another; (TA;) and general rules; (Msb;) and anything. (S.) See also 1, last sentence: and see شَوَّشَ. [Hence also,] هوّشت الرِّيحُ بِالتُّرَابِ The wind brought the dust of various sorts [mixed together]. (S, * IF, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
